modalLead: The first time you open Config → Appearance, a themed popover points at Random theme — the start of a reusable highlight system for new settings. Help and the manual now explain random picks and page-tab colour dots in more detail, the appearance sub-tab reads Theme instead of General, and the favicon asset is refreshed.

items.text: Config setting promo for Random theme — on desktop, the first visit to Config → Appearance shows a one-time themed popover below the Random theme dropdown, with a pulsing highlight on the field. Dismiss with Got it, Esc, or by changing the setting. Progress syncs via discoverabilityState.seenSettingPromos in settings.json. Add future highlights by registering an entry in config-setting-promos.js and anchoring the field with data-config-setting-promo-anchor.

Appearance sub-tab labelled Theme — the panel that holds your saved theme, random picks, fonts, and background is now Theme (not General / Algemeen), beside Custom themes, so it matches what you actually configure there.

Help and MANUAL cover random theme and page-tab dots — Config → Help → Appearance and Workspace explain random theme modes and double-click tab colour dots; MANUAL.md matches. Config → Overview → Latest update summarises this patch from the same what's-new data as the ★ modal.
Favicon updated — the root favicon.png is replaced with a smaller, cleaner asset.
